name: Maelin Voss
description: Wants Hrill to help people coordinate; owes Len safe practical help; will take sheep-track rather than sacrifice him for the load.

score.want: Find a usable northern road with willing competent company
score.ought: Wants Hrill to help people coordinate; owes Len safe practical help; will take sheep-track rather than sacrifice him for the load.
tactics: withdraw or resist a concrete threat
observed: s8 Ashen Span: asked Hrill to hold belayed rope; passed free end when he agreed, then knelt by jack and pointed out trapped boot and tipping risk.
s8 Ashen Span: secured successful lever to stone post once Len free; cart remains supported, not recovered.

s8 hearth: keeper introduced her to Hrill by name and relayed his offer to accompany Wind Stair survey. Joined map, set down rope and proposed first-light departure; answer pending. Has not heard Hrill private hope/Purewater conversation.

s8: Hrill confirmed first-light departure, asked about route and pay. Showed limit of lower survey, warned ledges/shale, offered1GP/day and food for three scouting days; no transfer or pay acceptance yet.
s8 hearth: Hrill accepted1GP/day and food for three-day survey. Pointed out map holdings and Alder Hame house, stated she does not know current occupants; no secret knowledge or past visit claimed.

d9/dawn: Hrill offered formal courtly bow and service at slab hazard. Returned small courtly dip. Engineering35/65 identified safe upper shelf approach; proposed rope loop and controlled pull, offered rope coil; nothing rigged yet.
d10/day: Hrill accepted White Cairn introduction and quietly asked me to inform Serevan. Agreed to convey visit concerns exclusion; no message delivered yet.
d12/dusk: Hrill agreed inspection and thanked me. Took measuringline/rule tospringground Serevanshowed; no surveyconclusion yet.
d17/day: Hrill explicitly gave me charge, then lifted on count (Brawn23/70success) and helped paid crew complete two half-day clearance sessions; lowerroad open. Asked his onward plans.

doing.goal: Make completed road known and continue own practical work
doing.next: Remains Three Hearths after introducing Edda; has not joined lake voyage or accepted new hire

survey_offer.scope: One day to pass, one day scouting, one day back; further work requires new agreement
survey_offer.status: Three-day engagement settled on return d10/day; lower route unresolved

actor_notes: LOOKS: road-browned young woman in a patched surveying coat. CORE: work must stand up after she leaves. NATURE: brisk, sociable when unhurried, delighted by a well-made thing. WOUND: once trusted a contractor whose work injured a colleague. WANTS: help freeing the carrier and getting the supplies north. PRESSURE: insists on controlling tasks she should delegate. KEY: short concrete verbs, impatient with grand promises.
